title: FieldGuideRAG: Image-Grounded GraphRAG for Fine-Grained Recognition with Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.40971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present FieldGuideRAG, a training-free GraphRAG method in which a vision-language model, or VLM, recognizes fine-grained species by comparing the query with real photographs stored on the nodes of a knowledge graph. Multimodal GraphRAG systems describe each entity in text, and text conveys little of the visual detail that separates look-alike species. Our graph stores one photograph on every species node and links each species to its relatives, its geographic range and its ecological facts. A frozen VLM verifies the query against the photograph of each candidate node. FieldGuideRAG fuses the verification scores with the range edge and answers questions about the organism from the fact edges of the verified species. On CUB-200, a Wikidata graph and four iNaturalist domains, the node photograph improves verification over the species name on every graph, while text descriptions add little. translated_title: FieldGuideRAG：面向视觉语言模型细粒度识别的图像化GraphRAG方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了FieldGuideRAG，这是一种无需训练的GraphRAG方法，其中视觉语言模型（VLM）通过将查询与存储在知识图谱节点上的真实照片进行比对来识别细粒度物种。多模态GraphRAG系统通常用文本描述每个实体，而文本几乎无法传达区分相似物种所需的视觉细节。我们的图谱在每个物种节点上存储一张照片，并将每个物种与其近缘物种、地理分布范围和生态事实相关联。一个冻结的VLM针对每个候选节点的照片对查询进行验证。FieldGuideRAG将验证分数与地理分布边缘信息融合，并从已验证物种的事实边缘回答有关该生物的问题。在CUB-200、Wikidata图谱以及四个iNaturalist领域的数据上，节点照片在所有图谱上都比物种名称显著提升了验证效果，而文本描述的贡献甚微。
tldr: FieldGuideRAG通过在知识图谱的物种节点上存储真实照片、并利用冻结的视觉语言模型进行图像验证，实现了一种无需训练的GraphRAG方法，显著优于基于文本描述的细粒度物种识别。
en_tdlr: FieldGuideRAG is a training-free GraphRAG method that stores real photographs on species nodes of a knowledge graph and uses a frozen vision-language model for image verification, substantially outperforming text-based descriptions for fine-grained species recognition.
